capabilities: Track note opens and edits as per-note aggregates
Show usage totals and most-active notes for the month
List notes ready to refresh across five staged intervals with deadlines
Render a pinned link graph of the open note's neighbourhood or the whole vault
Search notes by name or path and open them in a new tab
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition plugin; the refresh stages only flag notes you opened but have not revisited, they never quiz note content.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Data is stored locally in data.json as aggregates; an upgrade path from version 0.0.1 converts the old note-views.json file and backs it up.
intentEvidence: drawn and laid out with the same formulas as the core Graph view
problem: Obsidian keeps no statistics on how you actually use your notes and gives no reminder of which notes you opened but never revisited.
summary: Sidebar dashboard that tracks note views and edits, lists notes due for refresh in staged intervals, and pins a link graph to the panel.
